meta.title: @tpcowork/dsh-browser
meta.description: Browser capability layer: connects web tools, visible sidebar pages and the Electron desktop bridge. Owns tab access, persistent logins, manual takeover, screenshots and downloads so the assistant and user share the same pages as an independently managed capability.

ui.title: Browser
ui.empty: Enter a URL to browse. Website logins are saved automatically.
ui.unavailable: Browser is not ready. Install the matching desktop bridge and enable the plugin.
ui.settingsIntro: Sessions and workspaces in this application share website logins.
ui.importHelp: Import Chrome cookies and local storage. macOS may request Keychain access.
ui.clearConfirm: Clear all cookies, website storage and permissions? This closes browser pages and signs you out of websites.
ui.noPermissions: Allow or deny permissions when websites request them.
ui.importUnavailable: No data could be imported. Check that Chrome is installed and signed in.
ui.importDenied: Keychain access was denied. Retry the import or sign in here.
ui.importPartial: Some website data could not be imported. Sign in to those websites again.
